description: This source file defines the ValidatorActionFilter class which implements the IActionFilter interface. It intercepts ASP.NET Core MVC actions to validate the ModelState and returns a JSON-formatted error response with status code 422 if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A custom ASP.NET Core MVC action filter that validates the model state before executing an action and returns a JSON error response if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Intercepts action execution to check model validity. If invalid, constructs a JSON error response with a 422 status code.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: An empty implementation of the IActionFilter interface method, called after the action executes.
